svg.title: Production-grade ingestion flow with BDA, OpenSearch, and operational guardrails
svg.desc: Sources land in an S3 raw zone. A Step Functions workflow invokes Bedrock Data Automation to parse multimodal content, with retry and dead-letter handling on failure. Successful output lands in an S3 processed zone, feeds a Bedrock Knowledge Base that chunks and embeds into OpenSearch, with IAM access control and CloudWatch monitoring wrapping the whole pipeline.
